source: APEX VM Docket (Guideline) and APEX VM DISPLAY 2026

rules.rule: Group merchandise by category, style and colour family.
Use eye-level and slightly-below-eye-level positions for key merchandise.
Lower-price merchandise may be placed lower. Avoid positions that are too high or too low to see or reach.
Each brand wall retains its approved colours, POSM and visual identity.
A POSM occupies one row or one column. Two POSMs must not share the same shelf or wall column.
Fixture 1 has a maximum of 24 product options and uses raisers for best sellers and fresh stock plus a signage cube.
Fixture 3 has a maximum of 16 product options and uses raisers for best sellers and fresh stock plus a signage cube.
Avoid overcrowding. Use a curated weekly selection.
